name: smwsprites-mega-mole
title: Mega Mole
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite BF in SMW, the Mega Mole.

Yes, I know it's already been done, but this one is non-dynamic and, I'd like to think, easier to read than the one mikeyk included with Sprite Tool.

On extra bit set it'll be "Friendly", which means it can't hurt Mario.

(Rykon-V73): Converted the sprite and its extra bit to .json.
